verdict.rationale: Porkbun is an accredited domain registrar, and its core product depends on its registry relationships. A user cannot run that themselves, so self-hosting it is a category error rather than a missing feature. The evidence shows only hosted APIs, a hosted sandbox and mock endpoints, and moving DNS to the user's own Cloudflare account. None of these is a self-hostable version of the product, so they do not make the axis applicable.
